items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 27 at 4:11PM PST until November 28 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 7 feet with dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large
breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...An abnormally high tide of around 7.1 feet
will peak around 11 AM Saturday morning.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.
